did: Paired a new phone with home end to end. SIGNIN1 (#3094) adds the sign-in mark and home's standing. SIGNIN2 (#3108) adds a first-run welcome, one pairing form and the optional phone name. SIGNIN3 (#3113) adds sign out and pair again. SIGNIN4 (#3119) fixes the lan web's pairing words. SIGNIN5 (#3122) gives the viewer no passkey screen. #3125 says 'not found' and 'untrusted' as themselves, not 'away'. SIGNIN7 (#3150) lists, renames and signs out phones on the lan web. RN1 (#3103) and NL1 (#3098) are fixed. Then PO1: #3143 makes a page-load ask wait for the pairing record, #3168 makes 'is this phone paired' one union with 'reading' and teaches every reader to say nothing of no pairing while it holds, and #3169 gives a take's place 'unknown', so take rows, Studio and My data stop saying 'only on this phone' while the record is read. Two fresh reviews found reading guards that no test held; both now have held-read tests checked by mutation.

calls.title: On the phone, the screen says "signed in to home" for a phone paired with home that home still knows, and keep… (C470)
options: "Signed in to home" for the state, "pair" for the act
"Paired with home" for the state, as Settings › Home said before
"Signed in" for both, renaming pairing to signing in
calls.why: The owner asked for "clear visual communication that you're in a signed in session" while the app has always said "paired"; no check or earlier decision says which word the phone uses for the state, and the owner reads it on every screen.
calls.undo: Edit SIGN_IN and signInView in apps/www/src/lib/home-link/sign-in-words.ts, and ICONS in apps/www/src/components/device-sign-in-mark.tsx; nothing stores the words.

calls.title: A phone never paired with home opens on a welcome that pairs it, drawn in the foyer's place (no route of its o… (C471)
options: a welcome offered once, with "Not now" remembered
a welcome that blocks the foyer until the phone pairs
no welcome: a card on the foyer that offers pairing
calls.why: The owner asked for an onboarding flow that pairs a new phone, and named no way out; blocking would keep the phone's own wings (which work unpaired) behind home, and a card alone is what the owner found too easy to miss.
calls.undo: Have the foyer stop asking firstRun (routes/_dashboard/_apk/foyer.tsx); the remembered choice is one localStorage key, some-ui.home.welcome-not-now.v1.

scan a QR code the computer shows (address and code)

calls.title: Settings › Home offers Pair again only once home has forgotten the phone, beside Sign out of home, opening the… (C475)
options: Pair again only over a pairing home forgot, in place
Pair again over any pairing, replacing a working sign-in without a sign-out
no Pair again: sign out, then pair, as before
calls.why: The issue asks for pairing again in one step when home has forgotten the phone. Offering it over a known pairing too would leave home holding a working session for the old key that nothing signs out, and puts a second way to move to another home next to Sign out; offering it nowhere keeps the two steps the owner found awkward on a new phone.
calls.undo: Have mayPair in model.ts accept only an unpaired link and drop the Pair again button in device-section.tsx; the runtime's drainGone before a pairing then never runs.

calls.title: A request that failed because this phone couldn't find home's name on this network, or doesn't trust home's ce… (C476)
options: held as a silence, said as itself
said as itself, holding nothing back
said as itself, and no asks until the network changes
calls.why: Neither failure reaches home, but holding nothing back made every lane and screen ask at each moment, a burst the limiter work (HERD1) exists to stop, and the log filled; and an offline phone's resolver fails exactly as a router blocking the name does. Holding as a silence keeps the asks bounded, and a network change, a pull or Send now still ask at once once the person has fixed it.
calls.undo: Have runtime.ts `heard` dispatch only `blocked` for a HomeBlockedError, without `reached(false)`; nothing stores the choice.

calls.title: The lan web's phone list says when each phone was last used as "Used <day> or later" (C477)
options: "Used <day> or later", from the day its sign-in last renewed
"Last renewed <day>"
"Last seen <day>"
no time of use at all
calls.why: Home keeps no last-seen time, only when a phone's sign-in last started or slid (C493), which can be up to half a term behind its last use. "Last seen" would claim more than home knows, and "renewed" names the machinery the screen is not to show; saying the day as a lower bound is true and in the person's terms.
calls.undo: Change `PHONES.used` in lib/auth/phones/words.ts; nothing stores the choice.

calls.title: The phone keeps home's id for it and the name the owner typed while pairing in its pairing record, and its sig… (C478)
options: "paired as <name>", the name typed while pairing
"as <name>", the name typed while pairing, stale after a rename on the web
ask home for this phone's current name (a new route: home lists phones to a browser only, C497)
no name on the phone
calls.why: Home answers the account's phone list to a browser's passkey session only and refuses a phone's token (C497), so the phone cannot learn a name given on the web. Saying the name as current would go stale after such a rename; a new route for it is server work this story doesn't need. The owner sees the sentence on the phone's sign-in sheet.
calls.undo: Drop the `paired as` clause in sign-in-words.ts's signed-in line; the record's fields are read nowhere else.

calls.title: While the phone still reads whether it's paired with home, a take not yet on home says "On this phone", with n… (C480)
options: "On this phone", saying nothing of home, and My data waits for the read
"Kept on this phone", as for a phone known not to be paired
no place on the row until the read ends
calls.why: A take's place had no word for not known yet. "Kept on this phone" implies it stays there, which is false on a paired phone, and a blank place moves the row. No check or earlier call settles it; the owner sees it on every take row for the moments the record's read takes.
calls.undo: Map the unknown place to phone's words in take-words.ts, and drop My data's voiceKeptOnceRead for voiceKept.
